Before the deploy, searches succeeded (#149-151). web-bff's 500s ('upstream search-api returned 500', #175 onward) are only the effect showing up at the edge. verdict.recommendedAction: Roll search-api back to v2.8.0's predecessor, v2.7.8. Then fix product-formatter.ts:183 so it handles a missing locale object (null-guard or default), and add test fixtures for products without locale data before redeploying.
